summary: Suspension of sentence and bail granted pending appeal despite NDPS Act constraints; substantial incarceration (4.5/10 years) and delayed appeal hearing; Article 21 rights; bail not barred pre-completion of half sentence; one-time bail directives not restrictive; Dadu and Supreme Court Legal Aid Committee precedents considered; no interference with High Court order.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned order of suspension of sentence and bail upheld; liberty to apply for cancellation if conditions violated.
